name: Karasuma Setsuran
source: A genius female strategist who suddenly appeared amidst the chaos of war and became another member of the Four Heavenly Kings. Having trained under various military tacticians, she proposed revolutionary recruitment methods for the outnumbered Haguro army. Her strategies are ruthlessly effective, chilling even her allies. Usually quiet and expressionless, she becomes animated and joyful when discussing tactics in war councils or commanding on the battlefield.
